findings: Back-button resolves to `/` not history — `navigate({ to: "..", from: path })` navigates to the parent route segment, not the previous history entry. Works for all current flat routes; would misbehave on future nested dynamic routes. Replace with `router.history.back()` if browser-history back is ever needed.

`backdrop-filter-none` not a Tailwind v4 core utility — used in settings `sticky-save-bar` reset at `sm+` breakpoint. If Tailwind does not emit this class the blurred sticky bar will render on desktop. Confirm with a CSS grep of the build output or switch to `sm:backdrop-blur-none`.
